The living identity

One tick. A new place.

Zu stays fixed. Every clockwise step brings the next name into view.

Position 01 / 12 · Zone

Zone → Infinita → muShanghai → Futura → Zanzalu → ShanHaiWoo. One name per tick; the six-name sequence repeats twice over the twelve-position ring. Click the clock to advance, or let it play.

Motion study: one tick every 1.5 seconds compresses the annual cycle into 18 seconds. Positions represent months; names are an illustrative sequence, not a dated event calendar.

Meaning

A simple mark. Three connected ideas.

01 / Time

Twelve months

Twelve evenly spaced positions recall a clock. One full clockwise turn represents the cycle of a year.

02 / Place

One globe

The circle evokes the world. Individual dots suggest distinct communities connected within a shared whole.

03 / Presence

A moment in focus

The lime marker highlights one active position. It replaces a regular dot; it never becomes a thirteenth point.

Use forest on cream or cream on forest for essential text. Lime is an accent, not a body-text colour. Keep the interface predominantly cream and forest.

Typography

Character with clarity.

Zu. A place to belong.
Cormorant Garamond · Medium 500

Logo lettering, headlines and expressive statements. Preserve the capital Z and lowercase u.

Discover your next community.
DM Sans · Regular 400

Body copy, navigation and labels. Keep supporting text concise, spacious and easy to read.

Logo system & usage

Consistent at every destination.

Construction & space

  • 12 positions, evenly spaced at 30° intervals.
  • One lime dot, eleven standard dots.
  • Keep clear space of at least one lime-dot diameter.
  • Full circular mark: minimum 64 px tall on screen.
  • Below 64 px, use plain “Zu” without the ring.
  • Do not stretch, add effects, alter colours or add orbit text.

Names & motion

  • Keep the Zu symbol, baseline and word size fixed.
  • Reserve room for the longest name; do not shift the symbol.
  • Advance the lime marker and name together on every tick.
  • Use exact casing, including muShanghai and ShanHaiWoo.
  • Pause automatically for reduced-motion preferences.

Alternate expression

midju

Use Zuzone as the master brand. Zu midju is a separate hub-oriented expression, outside the six-name animation sequence. Midju means centre or focal point in Lojban.

Brand character

Welcoming. Worldly. Curious.

Speak like a thoughtful host: invite people into a place, help them find their community, and keep the language human and clear.

Use the standalone symbol for avatars and compact placements. Use the horizontal name version for page headers, community pages and motion.
